verdict.rationale: Community reports indicate Datadog publishes list prices on its website and largely sticks to them (comm-3), and that discounts are applied off those website prices (comm-4), so a self-serve cost estimate appears possible. However, there is no first-party pricing evidence in the pack. A $6M/yr customer cites lack of billing transparency as the reason they left (comm-8), and others say on-demand costs escalate quickly (comm-1, comm-19). Together these undercut how predictable costs really are. Missing for 10: first-party published pricing documentation, explicit per-signal (hosts/logs/spans/metrics) rate breakdown, cost calculator or estimation tooling, and corroboration that bills match predictions.
